name: SuperVP
description: Analysis of the audio signal with the SuperVP engine (spectrogram, fundamental frequency and partials) by Axel Roebel and Frédéric Cornu, based on an initial version by Philippe Depalle.

name: IrcamBeat
description: Beat and tempo detection and tracking based on the IrcamBeat library by Geoffroy Peeters and Frédéric Cornu.

name: IrcamDescriptor
description: Extraction of the spectral and temporal audio descriptors based on the IrcamDescriptor library by Geoffroy Peeters and Frédéric Cornu.

name: Pm2
description: Analysis and tracking of the harmonic and inharmonic partials of the audio signal with the SuperVP engine by Axel Roebel and Frédéric Cornu, based on an initial version by Philippe Depalle.

name: Fcn
description: Monophonic pitch (F0) estimation of speech signals with deep learning models by Luc Ardaillon and Axel Roebel.

name: VAX
description: Voice alignment based on the VAX (voice aligner) library by Guillaume Doras, Yann Teytaut and Axel Roebel.

name: Whisper
description: Speech recognition generating markers for the words and the syllables of the audio stream with the OpenAI Whisper models.

name: Crepe
description: Monophonic pitch tracking based on the CREPE deep convolutional neural network by Jong Wook Kim, Justin Salamon, Peter Li and Juan Pablo Bello.

name: IPT
description: Recognition of the instrumental playing techniques with deep learning CNN models by Nicolas Brochec, Joakim Borg and Marco Fiorini.
